result.title: CANDOR: Contrastive Self-Denoising Rewards for Label-Free Text-to-Image Post-Training
result.summary: Post-training text-to-image generators with reinforcement learning usually relies on external reward models that need annotated preferences or auxiliary evaluators and are prone to reward hacking. We show that the generator's own denoising accuracy, used by a recent intrinsic reward, is a poor proxy for prompt fidelity. Within a same-prompt group, this absolute self-confidence is dominated by image complexity and ranks correct samples above incorrect ones near chance. We introduce CANDOR (Contrastive Alignment from Null-referenced Denoising lOg-Ratio), the log-ratio of unconditional to conditional denoising errors under shared noise probes, which measures how much the prompt helps the model denoise its own sample. It cancels prompt-independent difficulty that scales both errors and ranks the better of two same-prompt samples higher in 60% and 63% of pairs on compositional generation and text rendering. As the only Flow-GRPO reward for a flow-matching model, CANDOR improves text rendering, aesthetic and human-preference scores over the base model and a prior absolute self-confidence reward, with text-rendering and preference gains that stronger classifier-free guidance does not reproduce. On public Flow-GRPO adapters trained on external rewards, CANDOR further raises PickScore and ImageReward, so it can complement those rewards. Code is available at https://github.com/jhlee0619/candor.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文指出文生图模型自身的去噪置信度不能可靠反映提示词忠实度，转而提出 CANDOR：在共享噪声探针下，用无条件下与有条件去噪误差的对数比作为内在奖励做 Flow-GRPO 后训练，无需外部奖励模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「空条件参照 + 同提示组内对比」以抵消与提示无关的难度并分离提示词的真实贡献，这种去除混杂的贡献归因思路可能可供核查：是否可借来构造视觉旁路或语言先验的对照基线，判断 VLM 推理中视觉证据是否被实际使用；但论文本身不涉及多模态推理状态。
